As part of an ongoing research collaboration in Germany, Dr. Denis Anikiev visited the GFZ Helmholtz Centre for Geosciences in Potsdam and delivered the invited seminar *Toward Generative Subsurface Models: Diffusion-Based Approaches for Geophysical Inversion and Geological Modeling*.

The seminar presented recent work on diffusion-based geophysical inversion, uncertainty-aware subsurface characterization, and integrated geological modeling. Technical discussions during the visit focused on the next generation of GeoSIRR and opportunities to combine generative AI with geological knowledge and reproducible modeling workflows.
